rootMotion: removed; fixed-step character controller owns world displacement
sourceAxes: +Y up, +Z forward, +X left; forward verified from positive root travel in RM clips
targetAxes: Blender +Z up, -Y forward, +X left; export_yup gives glTF +Y up, +Z forward
retarget: original target pelvis/torso/clavicle balance and mean arm carriage with bounded mean-relative source dynamics/swing; periodic source filtering/C1 time warp, fixed target limb lengths, stabilized-knee two-bone IK, actual skinned-shoe floor fit, analytical C1 foot pitch/clearance and speed-constrained heel-to-toe stance/polynomial swing recovery

posturePolicy.baseline: sample original target walk/run/sprint action before replacement; preserve its anatomy and speed-appropriate balance
posturePolicy.sourceTransfer: clavicles and arms use mean-relative body-frame source rotation deltas; torso uses bounded mean-relative dynamics; absolute source clavicle and spine directions and static arm bias are forbidden
posturePolicy.acceptance: numeric probes bound mean posture change against original target clips; visual side/front review remains required

phase: left foot enters stable near-ground support at normalized phase 0; right strike is at 0.5
interpolationPolicy: Saved Blender scene contains dense120Hz LINEAR authoring keys at fractional30Hz frames. Walk, Run and Sprint use a deterministic GLB postpass with hemisphere-unwrapped quaternion samples and central periodic CUBICSPLINE tangents. Sampled poses match; between-key interpolation differs and is independently checked.
reviewPolicy: Re-import actual exported GLBs; capture front/side views at eight phases across every gait cycle for both variants. Offline review complements actual-game camera/control/transition review.
durationPolicy: shared natural gameplay cadence1.0/.7/.6seconds; adapt source support duty and planted-foot fore-aft trajectory to actual gameplay speed rather than slowing long-stride source jog/sprint to moon-walk cadence; source support fit and RM travel are independently recorded
verification: actual skinned target shoe vertices are fitted before export; exported GLB tracks/shoes and runtime blending require independent verification
